features.name: age_life_stage_bucket
features.expected_model_benefit: Turns a continuous age field into coarse thresholds, giving trees simple split candidates.

features.name: education_attainment_bucket
features.expected_model_benefit: Converts the schooling scale into ordered levels, reducing the need for multiple adjacent numeric splits.

features.name: weekly_hours_bucket
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides direct part-time, standard, extended, and extreme schedule regions for tree thresholds.

features.name: prime_working_fulltime_indicator
features.description: Indicator for x001 between 30 and 60 with x013 at least 35, representing an established full-time working pattern.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures nonlinear co-occurrence of mid-career age and at least full-time schedule in one binary split.

features.name: advanced_education_overtime_indicator
features.description: Indicator for x005 at least 13 and x013 at least 45, representing high schooling with elevated weekly hours.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights rows combining high schooling and elevated weekly hours, a useful interaction for tree branches.

features.name: capital_gain_bucket
features.expected_model_benefit: Isolates zero, small, moderate, large, and very large x011 spikes in a form trees can split cleanly.

features.name: capital_loss_bucket
features.expected_model_benefit: Separates the common zero region from sparse x012 magnitudes with compact split-ready bins.

features.name: net_gain_capital_log
features.description: Log-scaled excess of x011 over x012, floored at zero.
features.expected_model_benefit: Handles the extreme right tail in x011 while keeping a zero region that tree splits can isolate.

features.name: household_context_code
features.description: Joint categorical context code formed by x006 and x008, preserving both codes in a single integer.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a compact interaction of two related categorical context codes so trees can form branches on joint household patterns.

features.name: work_context_code
features.description: Joint categorical context code formed by x002 and x007, preserving work setting and role code information together.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a compact interaction of work setting and role codes, enabling direct splits on common joint work patterns.

features.name: career_maturity_judgment_score
features.description: Ordinal semantic score from 0 to 5 assigned from x001, x005, x013, x002, and x007. A value of 0 represents an early or lightly attached work profile; 5 represents a highly established and intensive work profile.
features.expected_model_benefit: Summarizes multi-column career context into a small ordered signal; trees can split coarse profiles early and refine with raw fields.

features.name: resource_complexity_judgment_score
features.description: Ordinal semantic score from 0 to 5 assigned from x011, x012, x013, x005, x006, and x008. A value of 0 represents no monetary movement with simple work and household context; 5 represents substantial monetary movement with intensive schedule or advanced schooling context.
features.expected_model_benefit: Condenses monetary movement, workload, and schooling context into an ordered profile, giving trees an additional semantic split axis.
